ReleaseNotes: SnipEX 2.2.19 fixes text being cut off at the bottom of the fields in fill-in expansion windows (and other text boxes) since 2.2.16. Nothing else changes; snippets, synchronized libraries, preferences, and sign-in state are preserved. Per-user installation needs no administrator elevation. This employee-testing release remains unsigned. Windows ARM64 uses the x64 compatibility package, not a native ARM64 build.
